title: Finite pushforward preserves and reflects finite presentation near a singleton fibre
statement: Let $p:T\to U$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] that is of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], let $t\in T$ and $u=p(t)$, and assume $p^{-1}(\{u\})=\{t\}$. For every quasi-coherent $\mathcal M$ on $T$ [pqf-def-coherent], $\mathcal M$ is of finite presentation on a neighbourhood of $t$ if and only if $p_*\mathcal M$ is of finite presentation on a neighbourhood of $u$ [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Moreover, $\mathcal M_t$ is finitely presented over $\mathcal O_{T,t}$ if and only if $(p_*\mathcal M)_u$ is finitely presented over $\mathcal O_{U,u}$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].
